label: PF Backlog 575
title: EPIC: Eventing & Alerting SSOT - Go-first event bus + subscriber/alert transports
body:
## Problem / why
Eventing + alerting is fragmented: canonical lifecycle stream (core/events.py) is emit-only; a second
orchestration stream + in-process handlers exist (core/event_bus.py); subscribers are bespoke
(agent_messenger topics, legacy dashboard websocket, notification_system, alerts email). No cross-process
subscriber, no pluggable transports, no subscription/alert-rule registry. ADR-0001 (Go-first) requires new
shipped/sensitive logic in Go, so the new bus core must be Go with Python as a thin client.

## Goal / value
One SSOT event+alert bus used by all of PF. Producers emit once; consumers subscribe through stable
contracts (inproc in-process, SSE for UI, webhook for external, notify/email). Anyone needing
eventing/alerting calls the API - no bespoke plumbing. Existing wired paths keep working during migration.

## In scope
- Go event core (store, emit, monotonic seq, cursor), subscriber registry, dispatcher, transports, alert policy.
- Python thin client over the A1 wire seam; migrate existing consumers behind compatibility shims.
- Contracts (envelope+seq, subscription, alert-rule, webhook signature) with Go<->Python parity.
- API surface: SSE stream + subscription CRUD; retire legacy websocket push (frozen dashboard).

## Out of scope
- Rewriting the Python FastAPI server; big-bang Python->Go; duplicating existing owners.
- The legacy dashboard UI (frozen/legacy_exempt).

## Acceptance criteria
- A producer emits once and N heterogeneous subscribers (inproc/SSE/webhook/email) all receive it, across processes.
- New capability lives in Go under go/ per ADR-0001; language_rule_check + wired_audit + precheck stay green.
- No existing event/alert consumer regresses (event/ssot/redaction/tracing/run_status tests stay green).

## Verification / test plan
- Contract parity test (Go<->Python); dispatcher retry/DLQ test; SSE test; webhook HMAC test.
- Full gate set: compileall, wired_audit, single_path_check, precheck, language_rule_check.

## Dependencies & links
- ADR-0001 / BI-PF-0387/0388 (Go-first); A1 contracts (Epic A BI-PF-0390); B1 Go core (BI-PF-0394).
- Related: BI-0142, BI-0020, BI-0195/0198, BI-0049/0056, BI-PF-0332, BI-PF-0345, BI-PF-0260.
